_comment: Goldens for src/runtime/legacy-compat.core.js. kind=parity rows cite the PHP 7 AND PHP 8 manuals (documentation only, never executed). kind=decision rows are NOT parity claims: they follow D19 (or are rows the manuals do not settle) and are recorded in E-06. Escaping rows come from the Twig 1.35 html strategy = htmlspecialchars(ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE, UTF-8) (P-22).

numeric.php7: cmp, Warning block: before PHP 8.0.0 a string compared with a number is converted to a number; the PHP 7 output shows 100 == "1e2" is bool(true)
numeric.php8: cmp, Spaceship section: one operand a number and the other a numeric string -> compared numerically; num, Grammar: INT_NUM_STRING

numeric.php7: cmp, Warning block (string converted to number)
numeric.php8: cmp, Spaceship section (numeric comparison); num, Grammar

numeric.php7: cmp, Warning block (string converted to number); num, Behavior prior to PHP 8.0.0 (1 + "10.5" is float 11.5)
numeric.php8: cmp, Spaceship section; num, Grammar: FLOAT_NUM_STRING / DNUM

numeric.php7: cmp, Warning block: PHP 7 output for 100 == "1e2" is bool(true) (exponent form is read as a number)
numeric.php8: cmp, Spaceship section; num, Grammar: EXPONENT_DNUM

numeric.php7: num, Behavior prior to PHP 8.0.0: a string was considered numeric if it only had leading whitespaces
numeric.php8: num, Grammar: INT_NUM_STRING starts with WHITESPACES

numeric.php7: cmp, Warning block (string converted to number)
numeric.php8: cmp, Spaceship section; num, Grammar: FLOAT_NUM_STRING

numeric.note: Neither manual page states the PHP 8 result of comparing an int with the empty string (cmp only implies, through 0 == "a", that the pre-8 conversion no longer applies to non-numeric strings). Not settled by the manuals -> decision, E-06.
PHP 8 grammar allows trailing whitespace; the PHP 7 manual classes it leading-numeric and does not state the comparison outcome -> decision.
leading-dot fraction: PHP 8 grammar DNUM only; PHP 7 grammar is not on the page

yearMatches.php7: num, Behavior prior to PHP 8.0.0 (leading whitespace numeric)
cmp, table 'Comparison with Various Types', row null or string vs string: numerical or lexical comparison

yearMatches.note: int vs empty string in PHP 8 is not stated by the manuals
D19 (0x7E3 is 2019 in hex, still no match)

lastValue.note: P-24: the official manual pages (reserved.variables.get, function.parse-str, language.variables.external) are silent on repeated keys; only a user-contributed note on parse-str says PHP overwrites. Not settled by the manuals -> decision; URLSearchParams.getAll + last is the design rule (DD-21).

lastValue.php7: get: $_GET holds the URL parameters, values passed through urldecode()

lastValue.note: D19: a bracketed key is another key

escapeSource: hsc: translation table; ' for ENT_HTML401 with ENT_QUOTES (Twig 1.35 uses ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, P-22)
